s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive systemic inflammation with polyarthritis and granulomatous lesions
salient_findings: Six weeks of low-grade fever and fatigue
Progressive polyarthritis affecting large joints
Multiple dull red tender nodules on the forehead, left cheek, and sternum
Solitary firm right cervical lymph node
Liver palpable 4 cm below the right costal margin
Bilateral upper and mid-zone chest radiograph parenchymal infiltrates with nodular lesions
key_facts: No history of high-risk sexual behavior
Negative for antinuclear antibodies, IgM-rheumatoid factor, antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies, antistreptolysin O, and anti-DNase B antibodies
Normal serum calcium and angiotensin-converting enzyme levels
Negative urine examination for Gonococci spp.
Negative serum Venereal Disease Research Laboratory test for syphilis
Skin lesion biopsy: Granulomatous inflammation with suppuration
Cervical lymph node biopsy: Large areas of necrosis rimmed by epithelioid cell granulomas with occasional Langhans' multinucleated giant cells
Ziehl-Neelsen staining: Positive for acid-fast bacilli

shortlist.label: Tuberculosis
shortlist.why_kept: Positive Ziehl-Neelsen staining for acid-fast bacilli and granulomatous inflammation

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation with suppuration and epithelioid cell granulomas

shortlist.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic inflammation with polyarthritis and granulomatous lesions

shortlist.label: Adult-onset Still's disease
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic inflammation with polyarthritis and fever

raw.rationale: The presence of acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen staining, granulomatous inflammation with suppuration in skin lesion biopsy, and epithelioid cell granulomas with Langhans' multinucleated giant cells in cervical lymph node biopsy are characteristic findings of tuberculosis.

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: Normal serum calcium and angiotensin-converting enzyme levels, and lack of other typical sarcoidosis findings

rejected.label: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
rejected.why: No evidence of vasculitis or antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies

rejected.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
rejected.why: No evidence of vasculitis or aneurysms

rejected.label: Adult-onset Still's disease
rejected.why: No fever pattern, no rash typical of Still's disease, and lack of other characteristic findings
